reserveReview.rationale: The September 14 issuer response reports USDC $90,102.080832, frxUSD $482,631.869317 and Base treasury USDC $105,708.960000. Values normalized over $678,442.910149 supply the three rounded weights. Ethereum custodian totalAssets reads reproduce the first two values. The treasury is currently USDC; a planned Korean Treasury Bond transition is not an observed bond holding. Holder identity and circulating-liability scope remain unverified and the live adapter remains degraded.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: KRWQ live custodian asset values normalized by current USD value
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The three collateral token categories are identified. This classification review does not verify custodian/treasury control or reconcile cross-chain KRWQ liabilities.

providers.name: Issuer-reported Ethereum custodian contracts and Base treasury

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The API exposes two Ethereum custodians and a Base treasury holding USDC. Ethereum totalAssets balances were reproduced, but the actual vault-to-KRWQ binding, treasury control, segregation, bankruptcy treatment and rehypothecation terms have not been independently established. Shinhan Securities was associated with the proposed Korean Treasury Bond sleeve; the current source reports treasury USDC, not a bond balance.
